faq.q: What is the weather like for a Marbella boat rental in December 2030?
faq.a: December in Marbella averages 16°C sea temperature, 10-12 knots wind from the west, and swell height of 0.5-1.5m. Sunshine lasts about 6 hours per day. This makes for comfortable cruising, especially midday. Always check a 5-day forecast before your charter.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat in Marbella during Christmas week?
faq.a: Yes, our fleet operates throughout December, including Christmas week. Book early as slots fill up for festive harbour tours. We recommend a 2-hour sunset cruise (€749 on Tier A boats) to see the Puerto Banús Christmas lights from the water.

faq.q: What boats are available for a December charter in Marbella?
faq.a: All boats are available, but smaller vessels like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are popular for short harbour tours. For larger groups, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a heated saloon. Pricing varies; use WhatsApp for quotes.

faq.q: Do you offer New Year's Eve boat rentals in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, we offer New Year's Eve charters from Puerto Banús. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours. Book by 15 December to secure your slot. All charters include skipper, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: What should I wear for a boat trip in Marbella in December?
faq.a: Bring layers: a warm jacket, scarf, and hat. The sea breeze can feel chilly at 16°C. Non-slip shoes are recommended. The boat provides a sheltered cabin with heating. Sunscreen is still advisable for midday sun.

faq.q: Is December a good time for whale watching in Marbella?
faq.a: December is not peak whale season in Marbella. You may spot dolphins, but for guaranteed sightings, summer months are better. Instead, focus on festive harbour tours and coastal views of La Concha mountain.

faq.q: How do I book a Marbella boat rental for December 2030?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on any boat. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Deposit required to confirm.

faq.q: What are the best destinations for a December boat trip from Marbella?
faq.a: Short trips to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés are popular. For a longer charter, cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande. The sea is usually calm, but always check conditions. Harbour tours around Puerto Banús are festive favourites for Christmas lights.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental weather December 2030 guide? You're in the right place. December in Marbella offers mild temperatures, calm seas, and festive charm. Average sea temperature is 16°C, wind around 10-12 knots, and swell 0.5-1.5m. Perfect for a harbour tour or coastal cruise. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, and all charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Whether you want Christmas lights from the water or a New Year's Eve celebration, this guide has everything you need.

For a full overview of our services, visit our Marbella boat rental page.

Typical December Weather in Marbella

December 2030 in Marbella sees average highs of 18°C and lows of 10°C. Sea temperature holds at 16°C. Wind is usually from the west at 10-12 knots, with occasional calmer days. Swell height ranges from 0.5m to 1.5m, making for comfortable cruising. Sunshine lasts about 6 hours per day, with sunrise around 08:15 and sunset at 18:00. Rain is possible but infrequent — pack a light waterproof jacket.

Best Boats for December Charters

For small groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are ideal for a quick harbour tour. For larger parties, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a heated saloon. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours. Tier A boats — Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 — start at €749 for 2 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

Festive Highlights: Christmas Lights in Puerto Banús

Puerto Banús transforms into a winter wonderland from late November to 6 January. The best way to see the Christmas lights is from the water. A 2-hour sunset charter on a Tier A boat (€749) gives you front-row views of the illuminated yachts and harbour. Bring a camera — the reflections on the water are stunning. For a more intimate experience, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) is perfect.

New Year's Eve Cruises from Marbella

Celebrate New Year's Eve 2030 on the water. We recommend the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) for a luxury experience with a free jet ski. Minimum 4 hours at €4,719. All charters include drinks and snacks. Book by 15 December to secure your slot. Alternatively, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers spacious decks for watching fireworks over Puerto Banús. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

December Charter Destinations

  • Puerto Banús Harbour Tour — See the Christmas lights and luxury yachts.
  • Cala del Faro — A short cruise to a scenic cove.
  • Cala Cortés — Calm waters, ideal for a midday stop.
  • Estepona — A 30-minute cruise west, with a charming old town.
  • Sotogrande — A longer trip for a festive lunch at a beach club.

All destinations are subject to weather conditions. Your skipper will advise the best route on the day.

Pricing and Booking Tips

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. All other boats require a WhatsApp enquiry for pricing. Deposits are needed to confirm. Book early for Christmas and New Year's Eve slots. For more details, check our Marbella boat rental page.

What to Pack for a December Boat Trip

Layers are key: a warm jacket, scarf, hat, and non-slip shoes. The cabin is heated, but the deck can be breezy. Sunscreen is still recommended for midday sun. Bring a camera for the lights and views of La Concha mountain. All boats provide water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks.
